Overview — your personal roadmap to professional growth

This passport belongs to you. Use it to learn, track progress, earn promotions, and celebrate milestones — from New Agent Training through Senior Agent. Bring it to coaching sessions, performance reviews, and promotion discussions.

Your name, current level, hire date, and supervisor are on the cover page above — scroll up any time to update them.
Intro to the New Career Passport Program

One-Time 90-Day Passport Growth & Development Period

The Customer Service Career Passport is designed to create more opportunity for every agent to grow, develop, and advance within our Call Center.

Because many of the standards and expectations are new or updated, every current agent will begin with a one-time 90-day Passport Growth & Development Period.

This period is your opportunity to learn the new standards, recognize the strengths you already bring to the team, build new skills, receive coaching, and work toward the Passport level you want to achieve.

Every Passport level is achievable, and every agent has the opportunity to grow.

Throughout the 90 days, your manager will meet with you to review your Passport, recognize your progress, identify opportunities for development, and help you understand what you can do to continue moving forward.

Your current level is simply a starting point—not a limit on where you can go. As your skills, knowledge, confidence, independence, consistency, and leadership grow, so can your opportunities within Western Elite.

At the end of the 90 days, your manager will confirm the level that best reflects your demonstrated strengths and performance.

If you need additional time to reach the level you are working toward, you may receive up to 60 additional days of focused development and coaching. If you demonstrate the standards of your desired level sooner, you can move into that level at that time.

Our goal is to give every employee a clear path forward, the support to develop, and the opportunity to achieve more.

Your experience and contributions to Western Elite matter. The Career Passport builds on those strengths by giving you a clear roadmap for continued development and advancement.

Know where you are.
Know where you want to go.
Know how to get there.

Your Passport is your opportunity to grow—and your leaders are here to help you succeed.

Your manager meets with you throughout — no surprises. At the end, you're placed at the level that matches your performance. The goal isn't to move anyone backward — it's a fair, clear path to grow: know the standard, know where you stand, know what's next, and know your leaders are here to help you get there.

There is no fixed timeline. Advancement is earned by meeting the required performance gates, completing training, demonstrating competency, and sustaining performance for the required review period.
How the program works
How you move up — and how you move down
Moving up. When you earn a promotion to a higher level, you'll have a one-on-one review every month to keep your development on track and confirm you're holding the new level.
Moving down. Every level's performance gates must be maintained. If you fall below your level's gates during a 30-day review, the process is:
  • Step 1 — a 30-day coaching & review period. Your manager works with you to bring performance back to the gate.
  • Step 2 — if you're still below the gate, a second 30-day review period begins.
  • Step 3 — if the standards still aren't met after the second 30-day review, you move down a level with the related pay adjustment. If you meet the standards, you keep your level.
Beginning at Level 3, agents may earn up to an additional $2.00/hr through five cross-training endorsements. A Level 4 agent who sustains Level 4 and all Level 1 endorsements (Trainer, Poster, SDR) for four consecutive quarters becomes eligible for Senior Agent and an additional $1.00/hr. See section 7.

WOW Call — what makes a WOW, examples & live coaching

A WOW call turns a routine order into a great experience — and often a referral. Learn the marks of a WOW call, borrow the example scripts, and use the live scorer to coach real calls.

Example WOW call — listen by section

A real WOW call, broken into its moments. Press play, or jump straight to a section to hear the skill in action.

The WOW Call Program — becoming the best customer service agents in the world
A five-phase program, about four weeks per phase. Agents move through the phases with weekly one-on-one coaching. Completing all five phases = graduating the WOW Call Program, which is required to move up to Level 3. Check off each scorecard question as it is consistently demonstrated.
Phase 1 — Mastering the proper greeting (~4 weeks)
Objective
  • Deliver a greeting the customer understands easily and that makes them feel remembered and valued.
  • Ask for the customer's name and use it naturally.
  • Set a positive, friendly tone for the rest of the call.
  • Establish a great connection for the rest of the call.
Training / activities
  • Role-play with different speeds and tones to hear and feel the difference.
  • Listen to calls together.
  • Listen to your own calls / self-score calls.
Scorecard questions
Phase 2 — Understanding the caller's needs & active listening (~4 weeks)
Objective
  • Enhance listening to pick up on customer emotions and concerns.
  • Validate the customer's initial purpose / concern by restating.
  • Listen carefully without interruption; be present, in the moment.
  • Avoid making assumptions.
  • Visualize the customer's situation using active listening and empathy.
Training / activities
  • Role-play.
  • Listen to calls together.
  • Build a list of common-issue questions and how to gather information.
  • Real ride-alongs to visualize different jobsite issues.
Scorecard questions
Phase 3 — Gathering information through good questions (~4 weeks)
Objective
  • Ask insightful, open-ended questions to fully understand the customer's needs.
  • Navigate a pricing and sales call; build confidence selling our benefits, price, and closing.
  • Help inform the customer of what we can offer.
Training / activities
  • Critical-thinking workshops to build a list of questions for each part of the call.
  • Role-playing and mock calls.
  • Live calls with the sales team.
Scorecard questions
Phase 4 — Providing solutions & confirming satisfaction (~4 weeks)
Objective
  • Match our services with customer needs.
  • Build the customer's confidence and trust in you and in Western Elite. Would the customer be happy to speak to you personally next time?
  • Ensure customers understand who WE are, the services we offer, and cultivate rapport that leads to referrals.
  • Verify the caller's purpose / issue was resolved, and recognize hesitant customers before ending the call.
Training / activities
  • Quiz knowledge of all company services.
  • Role-play scenarios where the customer is hesitant or not fully satisfied, and how to handle it.
Scorecard questions
Phase 5 — Self-identifying a Western Elite WOW call (~4 weeks)
Objective
  • Confidence listening to calls and recognizing whether it was a WOW call.
  • Develop the ability to self-score calls and score calls for peers.
  • Build customer confidence and trust; cultivate rapport that leads to referrals.
Training / activities
  • Listening and scoring calls with manager and supervisor.
  • Scoring 5 of your own calls per week.
Scorecard questions
Coaching one-on-one agenda
  • Call reviews — a combination of Spanish and English calls, minimum 5 calls reviewed per weekly session.
  • Feedback sessions — targeted feedback on the specific phase the agent is currently working on.
  • Set a goal — a timeline goal to master the phase you are working on.
  • Weekly coaching sessions — feedback on progress.
  • Practice session — practice the desired behavior through live calls and scrimmages, with the coach providing guidance.
What makes a WOW call
Examples & scripts

Build trust & rapport

How long have you been on this job?How long have you been working for (company name)?How long have you been in Las Vegas?Thank you for always having the dumpster number ready when you call in!

Sales / pricing — discovery & benefits

What kind of materials are going in the dumpster?What kind of project do you have going so I can get you the right dumpster?Have you heard of our 4-hour blue box guarantee? We can get you a clean, graffiti-free dumpster delivered today.

Sales / pricing — closing

We have same-day delivery — can I get that order in for you right now?I’ll just need your address and I’ll get that order started.Would you like to place the order now?

Secondary / trail close

If you don’t mind me asking, what’s keeping you from placing the order now?Totally understand you need a few prices — just keep in mind we allow more tons than anyone, so no overweight fees; our drivers place it exactly where you need it; and the dumpster you get is always clean and graffiti-free.

Offer a storage container

Yeah, I can take care of that exchange for you. By the way, did you know we offer storage containers for rent?

Introduce the text line

Hey John, wondering if you’d be interested in our text line? You can text your orders in instead of calling — a lot of customers love how convenient it is.

FINAL pickup — follow-up

What’s the next project you’ll be working on? How did this project go for you? How did WE do?I notice you’ve had a dumpster there for a while — is there a reason we’re picking it up this time instead of swapping it out?
